name: KH1FM Dual Wield Ground Prototype v1

runtime_scope.ground: base Valor rows only; no air/hop/ability-requiring rows
runtime_scope.air_and_casting: native KH1; additional offhand contacts not added to these in v1
runtime_scope.weapon: duplicate of current KH1 weapon; no secondary selection or inventory claim
runtime_scope.appearance: native model/textures/colours; imported ground poses only
runtime_scope.ground_contacts: both by default; optional offhand-only setting

limitations: No local KH2 install: runtime import, rendering, native contact and effect timing remain unverified here.
Optional upstream game-data tests did not exercise their real-data branches.
The Windows DLL was built on Linux, not executed in KH1 here.
Native hands and weapon contact alignment across different weapons/maps require gameplay.
Requires the earlier embedded offhand model replacement and competing weapon/moveset scripts to be disabled.
